# K-Logistikus opens Bicol hub to speed up regional deliveries

 Chie Manalo August 15, 2026 August 15, 2026 0 4 mins 

K-Logistikus Philippines is expanding deeper into the regions as it strengthens its nationwide logistics network with the opening of a new cross-dock hub in Tabaco City, Albay.

The 1,500-square-meter Bicol Crossdock Hub is designed to help businesses move goods faster across the region, shorten delivery lead times, and respond more efficiently to shifting consumer demand.

Strategically located along the Tabaco-Ligao Road, the facility will serve as a key distribution gateway to Camarines Sur, Sorsogon, Catanduanes, and Masbate, improving connectivity between mainland Bicol and nearby island provinces.

For K-Logistikus, the expansion reflects growing demand for faster, more flexible logistics solutions as companies seek to build more efficient and resilient supply chains.

results.author: Redakcja
results.text:
InPost uruchomi terminal typu cross-dock pod Toruniem - Portal TSL

 17 lipca 2026 GS Panattoni Logistyka Magazyny 

# InPost uruchomi terminal typu cross-dock pod Toruniem

 

 Panattoni

Deweloper Panattoni rozpoczął pod Toruniem budowę nowego terminalu logistycznego dla InPost. Obiekt typu cross-dock o powierzchni 16 500 mkw. zostanie zrealizowany w formule BTS i wesprze dalszy rozwój sieci logistycznej operatora.

Obiekt powstaje w pobliżu Węzła Lubicz, łączącego autostradę A1 – biegnącą od północnej do południowej granicy Polski – z drogą krajową nr 80. Dzięki temu możliwy będzie szybki dojazd do różnych części regionu i kraju.

Park logistyczny znajduje się 10 km od centrum Torunia oraz 53 km od Bydgoszczy.

Firma kurierska będzie mogła wprowadzić się do nowego terminalu już na koniec lata 2026 roku.

# LEASED! Value Truck has taken on Outpost infrastructure at 1501 N Walton Walker Blvd in Dallas to support their growing cross-border freight network. The 27-acre former FedEx facility includes a 154-door cross-dock, … · 2026-08-31T00:00:00+00:00

LEASED! Value Truck has taken on Outpost infrastructure at 1501 N Walton Walker Blvd in Dallas to support their growing cross-border freight network. The 27-acre former FedEx facility includes a 154-door cross-dock, a 9-bay maintenance shop, 800 parking spaces, and direct access to I-30 and Loop 12.

Value Truck will run cross-docking, transload, and LTL consolidation out of the site. It will also serve as the launch point for their autonomous truck operations, starting with the Dallas-Laredo lane. Standing up a terminal like this from scratch can take years of planning and heavy capital. Working with Outpost, Value Truck moved into a terminal that was already developed, permitted, and operating, and saved its capital for moving freight.

Congrats to the Value Truck team, and thank you to Jon Dandurand and Burr & Temkin for your partnership on getting this done.

# Rohlig SUUS opens new logistics hub in Szczecin to boost regional connectivity 

 

> Rohlig SUUS opens new logistics hub in Szczecin to boost regional connectivity 

Rohlig SUUS Logistics has opened a new logistics center in Szczecin, strengthening its operations in Poland and improving links with Scandinavia and Western Europe.

The new facility combines warehouse and cross-dock terminal functions. It replaces two previous locations, allowing the company to improve efficiency and streamline operations.

The site covers around 15,500 square metres. It includes 12,000 square metres of warehouse space and nearly 3,000 square metres of cross-dock area. The facility offers around 13,000 pallet positions and features 22 loading docks and a 40-metre external ramp.

The hub is located in the Kostrzyn-Słubice Special Economic Zone, close to key transport routes S3 and A6. This position supports efficient distribution across Poland, Scandinavia and Western Europe, as well as connections to nearby seaports. Operations are set to begin in the second half of May.
